title: Pragopolis - City explorer
author: MrCement1983
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I'm not sure whether I've fallen into the trap of creating yet another piece of AI slop or whether this project is actually worth pursuing.

I originally wanted to use AI to create a game for myself in the style of the old GTA games, but without the shooting — just something to play and relax with. After a month of work, it somehow turned into a 1:1 scale relaxing simulator of my hometown, Prague.

Using open data, I managed to transform the entire city's topology into a playable environment.

The game currently takes up around 2.5 GB, and I managed to fit the entire city of Prague into that size. It contains over 11,000 pre-generated map tiles, and the underlying map data can be updated relatively easily.

I also wanted to experiment with some aspects of the city's future development. I managed to implement planned and currently under-construction infrastructure projects relatively easily and efficiently, including a cable car across the Vltava River, the completion of Prague's inner ring road, and new tram lines and connections.

The game also features a small mission-based gameplay mode, where you can chase thieves, transport patients to hospitals, put out fires, deliver packages from one location to another, or work as a taxi driver.

Thanks to the imported public transport data, you can also experience what it's like to drive a bus or tram along real-world routes. The game features a fully functional GPS navigation system for vehicles, so there's no need to worry about getting lost. :-)

The game includes real-world public transport data covering trams, buses, the metro, the funicular, and boats.

The entire project is primarily a learning experience for me, helping me understand how to work with AI and AI agents. I'm not trying to push it on anyone, but a colleague who saw it told me that it's exactly the kind of relaxing game he'd enjoy playing.

I'm not particularly skilled when it comes to graphics, but I've always liked stylized, cartoon-like textures, which is why the game looks the way it does.

The game is being developed using Godot and Blender.

Unfortunately, I'm still struggling with certain aspects of development, particularly generating bridges and connecting them seamlessly to the surrounding roads, as well as ensuring that vehicles can travel through tunnels correctly. However, I think it's mainly a matter of better understanding how textures, road surfaces, and the underlying terrain fit together. In any case, the game is already playable.

**I'd really appreciate your feedback, especially on the following questions:**

* Would you personally enjoy playing a relaxing, open-world city simulator like this?
* Does the concept offer something interesting, or are there already similar games that do it better?
* What do you think about the visual style and gameplay shown in the video?
* What features or activities would make the game more enjoyable for you?
* Do you think it's worth continuing development and eventually releasing the game for free?

I'm genuinely interested in both positive and negative feedback. Don't hesitate to be critical — I'd rather understand what needs improvement than continue developing something nobody would actually want to play.

Thanks for taking the time to read this and share your thoughts!

**Welcome to PRAGOPOLIS!**
